findings.claim: The added installed readonly directory is separate from original business CatalogDependency and runtime-ready admission. It filters exact server-selected installation/tenant and reuses original full lock/hash/signature/artifact/roles/markings projection; every returned module is disabled with an explicit readonly blocker. No business/runtime admission is granted, and absent configuration returns empty without database access. Original operation routes and predicates are preserved.
findings.evidence: services/aos-api/aos_api/ecommerce_installed_readonly_catalog.py: InstalledReadonlyWorkshopCatalog.__init__ delegates to _SelectedInstalledSource, which only exposes read_runtime_candidate_bundles and rejects cross-tenant requests. _project_modules overrides super() to set WorkshopReadiness.DISABLED and append WorkshopReadinessBlocker with reasonCode='INSTALLED_ASSET_READONLY'. build_installed_readonly_catalog() returns empty catalog when env AOS_INSTALLED_READONLY_CATALOG is absent, and requires AOS_LOCAL_MANAGEMENT_OIDC_CONFIG/AOS_BUNDLE_ROOT before constructing. services/aos-api/aos_api/routers/ecommerce_workshop.py adds new GET /installed-readonly-modules without modifying existing /modules route. services/aos-api/tests/asset_registry/test_ecommerce_installed_readonly_catalog.py: test_cross_tenant_has_no_source_access verifies tenant isolation, test_unselected_installation_is_not_visible verifies installation selection, test_content_drift_is_rejected verifies signature/hash enforcement, test_original_permissions_remain_required preserves roles/markings checks, test_revoked_installation_is_re_read_instead_of_cached verifies cache behavior.
